root_cause.text: The `rx_hash_key_len` parameter from a userspace uAPI structure was not validated before being used as a size argument in `memcpy`, allowing userspace to specify an arbitrary length that could overflow the kernel buffer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a bounds check `if (rx_hash_key_len > sizeof(req->hashkey)) return -EINVAL;` before the `memcpy` operation. The CVE description explicitly states that `rx_hash_key_len` comes from a uAPI structure and was "blindly passed to memcpy, allowing the userspace to trash kernel memory." The fix validates that the user-supplied length does not exceed the actual size of the destination buffer (`req->hashkey`), preventing the buffer overflow.
